tabs.title: Company Overview
tabs.content:
**Brynflux Media** produces short-form advertising creative for retail brands. Its creative team currently hand-designs every image and short video clip used in social ad campaigns, which limits how many campaign variants they can test per week.

**Current Environment:**
- Brand briefs, product photos, and past campaign assets are stored in an Azure AI Foundry project (`brynflux-creative-foundry`).
- Editors review every piece of generated creative in a shared review queue before it is scheduled for publication.
- A small library of finished video ads is stored for reuse and remixing.
- The legal team has flagged that competitor logos and other brand marks must never appear in published creative.

tabs.title: Requirements
tabs.content:
**Generation Requirements:**
- Editors must be able to generate new campaign still images from a text brief plus a reference product photo, so the product itself is preserved in the output.
- Editors must be able to generate short promotional video clips from a text brief and a reference image.
- Existing video ads must be re-cut and captioned automatically to fit a new campaign without full regeneration.

**Orchestration Requirements:**
- A single request such as "turn this brief into a finished, on-brand video ad" must be handled by a solution that plans and coordinates the individual generation, captioning, and review steps rather than requiring the editor to invoke each step manually.

**Responsible AI Requirements:**
- Generated video must be scanned for disallowed content, including embedded competitor logos and other prohibited brand marks, before it reaches the review queue.
